Seminar group results: strong families, less violence and more jobs
se: The meeting summed up the results of the committee's seminar on population structure and quality of life: challenges and directions for Thai social policy in the next decade, for small group 2: strengthening families by reducing violence and creating jobs through the community economy. The group aimed to gather information, views and practical approaches for a model proposal, “a strong-women province with zero domestic violence”, to be presented to the Senate, linking 2 areas: women's role in creating jobs and income, and strong families and ending violence. The meeting summed up the results in 5 points and asked the secretariat to gather the proposals from the seminar for the report to the Senate. This meeting was held at the Parliament House and online.
it: Seminar results, small group 2: strengthening families by reducing violence and creating jobs through the community economy
Model proposal “a strong-women province with zero domestic violence” for the Senate

te: Progress on the Krabi Model draft report, and preparing the 12 November seminar
se: The meeting considered progress on the draft study report on policy proposals to build strong women with zero violence and zero unemployment at the local level. It invited provincial offices in Krabi (the provincial community development, labour, employment and statistics offices) to give information and views, so that the report and the work share the same direction and goals. The meeting also prepared the committee's seminar on population structure and quality of life: challenges and directions for Thai social policy in the next decade, on Thursday 12 November 2026 at the Parliament House, in 2 parts: a seminar and 4 small discussion groups.
it: Progress on the draft report: proposals to build strong women with zero violence and zero unemployment: the Krabi Model case study (information from provincial offices in Krabi)
Preparing the seminar on population structure and quality of life, 12 November 2026 (2 parts, 4 small groups)

te: Draft proposal on false birth registration, and the Krabi Model survey
se: The meeting considered a draft policy proposal on births registered with a false claim of Thai nationality, which may lead to nationality being obtained wrongly. The committee has heard the agencies concerned 5 times. Concerns raised included local birth registration without a hospital birth certificate, measures when a false registration is proven, and data links between registration agencies; the secretariat will revise the draft. The meeting then noted the first Krabi Model survey of more than 600 women in 5 pilot sub-districts: 40–42% are unemployed and 42% want job training. It also prepared the committee's seminar on 12 November 2026, where the subcommittee runs breakout room 2.
it: Draft policy proposal on births registered with a false claim of Thai nationality
Draft report on proposals to build strong women with zero violence and zero unemployment: the Krabi Model case study: first survey results in 5 pilot sub-districts

Progress on the Krabi Model and the next work plan
se: The meeting followed progress on proposals to build strong women with zero violence and zero unemployment: the Krabi Model case study, covering women's jobs, protection of rights, and prevention of violence against women and domestic violence. It set the next work plan in 2 areas: women, such as economic security, violence prevention and gender-responsive budgeting; and people of diverse genders.
it: Progress on proposals to build strong women with zero violence and zero unemployment: the Krabi Model case study
Next work plan for women and for people of diverse genders

te: Meeting summary video · Progress on the Krabi Model and the next work plan
The work plan for fiscal year 2027 and the Krabi Model case study
se: The meeting considered its work plan for fiscal year 2027 in 3 groups. Group 1 is a proposal on births registered and birth certificates issued that falsely name a Thai national as the father; information is being gathered from the agencies concerned. Group 2 is the report on proposals to build strong women with zero violence and zero unemployment: the Krabi Model case study, in 4 steps: a survey in 5 sub-districts, field hearings, a review of the model in November, and a draft report to the committee by December 2026. Group 3 is a later study on gender diversity. The meeting suggested linking budgets and funding sources, including the Women's Development Fund, to support job training.
it: The subcommittee's work plan for fiscal year 2027 (3 groups of work)
Proposal on births registered and birth certificates issued that falsely name a Thai national as the father

te: Meeting summary video · The work plan for fiscal year 2027 and the Krabi Model case study
Following Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality
se: The meeting studied progress on Sustainable Development Goal 5, gender equality and empowering women and girls, with the SDG research and support centre of the Office of the National Economic and Social Development Council, King Prajadhipok's Institute, the Department of Labour Protection and Welfare and the Office of the Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Labour. Proposals received included new surveys on time use and on the prevalence of violence, gender-responsive budgeting, and childcare and elder care services so that more women can join the workforce, in line with the 14th National Economic and Social Development Plan.
it: Progress on Sustainable Development Goal 5: gender equality and empowering women and girls
Proposals: time-use and violence surveys, gender-responsive budgeting, and childcare and elder care services
